response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior full-stack/web developer with a long track record, but he has essentially no relevant experience for this role: no evidence of Japanese language proficiency (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel source modification experience, no embedded/networking security work (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips), and his C experience is limited to one job over a decade ago with no UNIX systems focus. His skill set (JS/TS, Ember, DLang, web/mobile apps) is misaligned with the embedded firmware/security domain required.
strengths: Long, diverse senior engineering career with strong ownership and craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp up on unfamiliar technical domains (e.g., iOS/Apple TV takeover)
Some low-level/C/C++ background (National Instruments C IDE work, DLang systems-level work)
concerns: No mention of Japanese language skills, which is a hard requirement for this role
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation/modification experience
No background in embedded networking security (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, NETCONF/SNMP)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded security domain experience
